title: PHASE 02 — Survey & Spatial Definition
content:
To transform vision into buildable reality, a precise understanding of the existing conditions is essential.

During this phase, we carry out detailed architectural surveys and produce accurate drawings of the space to be renovated or rehabilitated.

Based on this analysis, preliminary layouts are developed to explore different spatial configurations and potential uses.

This stage combines technical precision with creative exploration, ensuring a solid and informed basis for the project’s evolution.
